verdict.rationale: BILL documents custom approval policies on its pricing page, and its API docs describe bill approval policies that control which bills need approval, by whom, and when. That suggests configurable approvers. However, the approval-policy docs relate to AP bills rather than clearly to Spend & Expense requests, and nothing shows sequential multi-step chains. missing for 10: evidence of multi-step chains (manager → budget owner → finance) within Spend & Expense, approver delegation, escalation or reminders when approvers stall, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
